goyt_errwood_0.text: Step in and picture it. Errwood Hall was built in the 1830s by Samuel Grimshawe. Today only the shell is left.
The valley was bought to protect the water for Stockport, and the hall was pulled down in the 1930s.
The family planted rhododendrons all around. They still turn the hillside pink and purple in early summer.
Keep an eye out for brocklings at dusk. They are the real owners of this valley.
